अमिताभ बच्चन की लाड़ली पोती आराध्या का जन्मदिन हुआ सुपर स्पेशल! 🎉
अभिषेक बच्चन और ऐश्वर्या राय बच्चन की बेटी आराध्या बच्चन ने सोलह नवंबर को अपना पंद्रहवां जन्मदिन मनाया है। 🎂
दादा अमिताभ बच्चन ने अपने पर्सनल ब्लॉग पर लिखा कि घर की पोती का जन्मदिन सुनहरा और भाग्यशाली रहे। 💖
खास बात यह है कि ऐश्वर्या और अभिषेक ने सोशल मीडिया पर बेटी के लिए कोई बर्थडे विश शेयर नहीं की है। 🤫
बिग बी इन दिनों KBC 18 की शूटिंग में व्यस्त हैं और जल्द ही Kalki 2898 AD के सीक्वल में नजर आएंगे। 🎬
क्या आपको लगता है कि स्टार किड्स को सोशल मीडिया से दूर रखना चाहिए? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Amitabh Bachchan pens a sweet birthday wish for granddaughter Aaradhya Bachchan as she turns 15, wishes her good fortune
ctx.summary: Amitabh Bachchan wished his granddaughter Aaradhya a golden and fortunate 15th birthday, sharing the message alongside photos from his Sunday darshan.
ctx.text:
Bollywood actors Abhishek Bachchan and Aishwarya Rai Bachchan 's daughter, Aaradhya Bachchan, celebrated her 15th birthday on November 16. Her grandfather and superstar Amitabh Bachchan shared a sweet birthday wish for her and also expressed gratitude to those who came to meet him during his Sunday darshan.
On Monday, Big B took to his personal blog and shared pictures from his Sunday darshan. Alongside them, he wrote, "Ghar ki poti ka janam diwas sunehra aur bhagyashaali rahe, yahi Ishwar se prarthana hai (May the granddaughter of the family have a golden and fortunate birthday. This is my prayer to God). The affection I received on Sunday was truly unforgettable. My heartfelt thanks for all your prayers and blessings."
Aishwarya and Abhishek, however, did not share any birthday wishes for their daughter on social media. Recently, Aaradhya was seen enjoying a Diwali party with her cousins, Navya Naveli Nanda and Agastya Nanda. A picture of her bonding with Agastya at the party melted hearts online.
Aaradhya Bachchan is the daughter of actors Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan. She is occasionally spotted accompanying Aishwarya at public events, on international trips and at the Cannes Film Festival. She also made headlines in 2023 when her family approached the Delhi High Court over misleading online content about her health. The court restrained several YouTube channels from publishing such content, emphasising the need to protect a minor's dignity and privacy.
Big B is currently busy shooting for Kaun Banega Crorepati 18. The superstar had taken a break from his usual social media updates last month after being advised to rest and recover, but returned to the sets on November 12.
On the big screen, Big B was last seen in Kalki 2898 AD. Helmed by Nag Ashwin, the sci-fi thriller saw the 84-year-old actor essay the role of Ashwatthama. His performance impressed viewers, with many praising him for carrying the film on his shoulders. The film collected over ₹ 1,000 crore at the worldwide box office.
Amitabh Bachchan will next be seen in the sequel to Kalki 2898 AD. The film also stars Prabhas and Kamal Haasan in lead roles. While the first instalment featured Deepika Padukone as the female lead, she is no longer part of the sequel. When shooting began in February this year, Big B expressed his excitement about reuniting with Kamal Haasan on set. The actor shared pictures of himself sharing a warm hug with him and wrote, "And meeting up with the great KAMAL HAASAN... we shall be working together after ages... last in Geraftaar."
Riya Sharma is a content producer at Hindustan Times who lives and breathes entertainment. If there’s gossip making noise in Bollywood or a reality show moment breaking the internet, chances are she’s already writing about it. She loves digging out the juiciest stories, spotting viral pegs and turning it into easy-to-read content.

A journalism graduate from IP University, Riya began her career as a social media executive, where she learned the art of grabbing attention in a scroll-heavy world. But her love for showbiz soon pulled her into entertainment journalism, because for her, it’s always been entertainment, entertainment and more entertainment.

An artist at heart, Riya has a deep passion for acting, music and dance, which shapes how she watches and writes about films and reality shows. She loves sharing her views and reviews, especially when something excites, surprises or completely disappoints her.

A hardcore reality show fan, Riya enjoys tracking every twist, task and meltdown, and breaking them down for readers who can’t get enough of high-voltage drama. Movies are equally close to her heart, whether it’s a big theatrical release or a binge-worthy OTT series, she’s always watching, and analysing what’s worth the time. She loves talking to celebrities, asking questions that go beyond the usual.
